title: Random Block Bounty
description: Break any block and receive a completely random item.
body:
## 🎲 Random Block Bounty

**Welcome to a world where traditional resource gathering is dead.
This mod ruthlessly throws out Minecraft’s standard progression and replaces it with pure, RNG madness. With it, every broken block becomes a loot box.**

![This mod replaces all standard block drops with completely random items.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14d5ee10b727cf4a8dee9808c3b052b9a93e01b6.png)

> Chopped down an oak tree? You might get a netherite ingot.

> Broke some sand… and got rotten flesh.

🎰 Absolute Randomness
When you break a block, the game rolls the dice and gives you a completely random item from a massive pool of every possible drop in the game.

## **✨ Why you should play with this mod?**

* Infinite replayability – no two playthroughs will ever be the same. Today you’re a king in full netherite armor within five minutes; tomorrow you can’t find a single torch for half an hour.

* Hilarious multiplayer – imagine a race with friends where one gets an elytra from sand, and another gets a stick from a diamond block. Screams, laughter, and chaos guaranteed.

* The perfect twist for a modpack – add this mod to any pack, and it instantly becomes a giant casino. Hardcore, Skyblock, adventure – break the usual playstyles.
